response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink COLLATE BINARY = tr.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref COLLATE BINARY = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT trader_type, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.trader_type, s.transaction_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value;
